author: Lynch, John
title: The Proto-Oceanic labiovelars: Some new observations
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (Project MUSE PDF; Table 3 read from a page image). Descriptions of labiovelars (Table 1), secure POc reconstructions with labiovelars (Table 2), sample reflexes in eleven languages with PEOc fortis *p and lenis *v (Table 3, p. 315), theories of origin (contact, conditioning, unrecognised precursor), phonotactic distribution and crossover (§3.3), conditioning by an adjacent rounded vowel with a post-velar (§5.2) or initial *u (§5.3), disambiguation and functional load (§6), with an appendix of cognate sets. Year suffix h: Lynch's grammar sketches in Lynch et al. (2002) are 2002a-g.
